nodes.title: H3 video VAE - INT8 encode and decode
FIXED seed - keep for all comparisons
START HERE - concentric colors and canvas
widgets_values:
# Concentric red / green mask + base canvas
Upload the included example_workflows/assets/Concentric_Center_Circle_RedGreen_150f.mp4 in the mask video loader, or copy it into ComfyUI/input and select it. See the pack README for example dependencies.

Select an image in each of the three empty image loaders: CANVAS, RED, and GREEN. Each branch has its own editable prompt. All three use first-image conditioning; no last frame is connected.

The red and green areas follow the supplied animated mask. The CANVAS branch is global context that participates everywhere in the same generation. Its strength starts at 0.65, matching the source workflow. This is one sampling process, not a rendered background with two finished videos overlaid.

## Mask profiles and mixing
The source workflow's average_inside profiles are retained: each color has weight 0.5 inside its mask and zero outside. Canvas strength stays independent. embedding_overlap and overlap_mix=1 enable the existing pairwise conditioning averages wherever weights overlap.

Choose interior_gradient on either profile for adjustable inward transition and outer fade. These widths are in mask pixels at 512 x 512. Smoothstep applies to interior_gradient. The blur control applies to gaussian mode. Width, outer fade, curve, and blur do not change average_inside.

## Timing and generation
The mask is 150 frames at 24 fps. All frames are used in order, with no skipped frames or retiming. The final frame is held for eight extra frames to match H3's 158-frame output length (about 6.58 seconds). Canvas size is 512 x 512, matching the supplied output workflow.

The original FL2VA INT8 model, matching eight-step LoRA, Euler/simple sampler, SageAttention, fixed seed, and audio/video decoding are retained. No upscaling is included.
